title: English Opening: King's English Variation
line: A Sicilian Defense with the colors reversed, and White has an extra move.

steps.text: Black answers with the king pawn. It is the Sicilian Defense with the colors reversed, and White has a move more.
Bring the knight out. It watches the center square d5.
Move the pawn on g2 one square to open the long diagonal.
steps.after: Black pushes into the center at once.

steps.text: Take on d5. A side pawn for a center pawn, as Black does in a Sicilian.
Put the bishop on the long diagonal. It attacks the knight on d5.
steps.after: The knight steps back. The long diagonal is open to the pawn on b7.

steps.text: Bring the other knight out. It attacks the pawn on e5.
Castle. Your king is safe behind the bishop on g2.
Move the pawn on a2 one square. It gets ready to push the pawn on b2 forward, toward the knight on c6.

also.d2d3: That is sound too. This lesson starts on the queenside at once.

steps.after: White plays on the queenside and on the long diagonal, as Black does in a Sicilian.

summary: Against the king pawn, White plays a Sicilian with an extra move: a side pawn for a center pawn, then queenside play.
